Subu, saw Energy Exemplar is pushing hard on global expansion, new EMEA and India leadership and the Xcelerate 2026 conference.

Scaling into new markets that fast usually means more accounts in play than your East and LATAM reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Energy Exemplar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

As the territory expands, pipeline expectations tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your East and LATAM region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
